name: WBI Demicks Lake Pipeline Project (2015)

values.EndLocation: Demicks Lake gas plant, near Keene, McKenzie County

researcher_notes: Not an early form of North Bakken (P3584). North Bakken was a 2019 project from Tioga to Elkhorn Creek. This 2015 project was a separate lateral to the proposed Demicks Lake gas plant near Keene, North Dakota, with a different federal docket (PF15-24). The later 2019 Demicks Lake to Cherry Creek project (12.2 mi) is a different, shorter project and is not covered here. FERC's June 2015 infrastructure update says WBI Energy began the pre-filing process for this project, with 221.5 MMcf/d of capacity for the ONEOK Rockies Midstream plant. That is the concrete step. The EIA release of August 2018 (sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 43) lists 22 mi, 24 in, 222 MMcf/d, status Cancelled, docket PF15-24, last updated 2018-01-24. Length and diameter rest on the EIA release alone, so medium tier. Start point not found; only the state is known. No route found. Owner entity lookup shows only a fuzzy match to WBI Energy, so source spelling kept; check for a match before applying. Parent company not verified, left blank. Length of 22 mi is about 35 km, above the 25 km threshold.
